chunks: Our angels came to Abraham with good news, saying, 'Peace.' He replied, 'Peace.' Then he hastened to bring a roasted calf.
ai.seo_question: What did Abraham do when the angels visited him with good news?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Prophet Abraham’s (AS) immediate hospitality, where he prepared a roasted calf to honor the angels who had come to announce the birth of Isaac and Jacob. This act of generosity is often linked to the concept of *ihsan* (excellion in worship and conduct), serving as a model for believers in welcoming guests with sincerity and haste.
